content.title: About
content.content: Cereal, cooked, NFS (3122) is a ready‑to‑eat product made from whole grains that have been heat‑treated to enhance flavor and digestibility. The flakes are soft, carry a light toasted grain aroma, and are suitable as a stand‑alone breakfast or as an addition to milk, yogurt, or smoothies.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Thermal processing retains most nutrients while making them more bioavailable.
NFS stands for “Not From Scratch,” meaning the product is ready to eat without further cooking.
Cereal flakes are popular in sports nutrition for their quick energy release.
The blend may include wheat, oats, barley, and rye, providing a broader amino‑acid profile.
When stored properly, the flakes stay crunchy for up to 12 months.

items.title: Rich in complex carbohydrates
items.content: Complex carbs provide a steady energy supply and help maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestion, promotes satiety, and contributes to gut health.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, and B6 are involved in carbohydrate metabolism and nervous‑system function.

items.title: Provides essential minerals
items.content: Iron, magnesium, and zinc in the flakes support blood formation and immune function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The product fits low‑fat diets while still delivering nutrients.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: People with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity may react to the product.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Large portions can cause a rapid rise in blood glucose.

items.title: Added sugars
items.content: Some varieties contain added sugar; choose unsweetened versions if monitoring calorie intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Eat the flakes dry, or add them to milk, kefir, yogurt, or plant‑based drinks. They can also be used in baking, as a coating, or in energy bars. For a softer texture, pour hot water or milk over the flakes and let them sit for 2–3 minutes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For extended shelf life, store in the refrigerator to preserve crunchiness and prevent mold growth.
